mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_server_report (server_id, sections, status_cd, req_user, req_dt, warn_cnt, byte_cnt) VALUES (#{serverId}, #{sections}, #{statusCd}, #{reqUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id, r.server_id, r.sections, r.status_cd, r.req_user, r.req_dt, r.sent_dt, r.done_dt, r.warn_cnt, r.byte_cnt FROM tb_server_report r WHERE r.server_id = #{serverId} ORDER BY r.req_dt DESC, r.report_id DESC
SELECT r.report_id, r.server_id, r.sections, r.status_cd, r.req_user, r.req_dt, r.sent_dt, r.done_dt, r.warn_cnt, r.byte_cnt, r.content FROM tb_server_report r WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId}
SELECT r.report_id, r.server_id, r.sections, r.status_cd, r.req_user, r.req_dt FROM tb_server_report r WHERE r.server_id = #{serverId} AND r.status_cd = 'REQUESTED' ORDER BY r.report_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_server_report SET status_cd = 'SENT', sent_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND status_cd = 'REQUESTED'
UPDATE tb_server_report SET status_cd = #{statusCd}, done_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, warn_cnt = #{warnCnt}, byte_cnt = #{byteCnt}, content = #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.server_id, p.interval_hr, p.sections, p.next_dt, p.last_req_dt, p.upd_user, p.upd_dt FROM tb_report_policy p WHERE p.interval_hr > 0 AND p.next_dt <= #{now} ORDER BY p.next_dt, p.server_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_report_policy (server_id, interval_hr, sections, next_dt, upd_user, upd_dt) VALUES (#{serverId}, #{intervalHr}, #{sections}, #{nextDt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_report_policy SET interval_hr = #{intervalHr}, sections = #{sections}, next_dt = #{nextDt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, upd_user = #{updUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE server_id = #{serverId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.svc_nm AS item_nm, s.script_path AS item_path, s.account_nm AS user_nm, s.state_cd, s.pid, s.state_dt AS dt FROM tb_service s WHERE s.server_id = #{serverId} ORDER BY s.list_no, s.svc_id

SELECT p.proc_nm AS item_nm, p.exec_path AS item_path, p.running_yn AS state_cd, p.pid, p.cpu_pct, p.mem_pct, p.upd_dt AS dt FROM tb_server_process p WHERE p.server_id = #{serverId} ORDER BY p.sort_ord, p.proc_id

SELECT s.log_nm AS item_nm, s.log_path AS item_path, n.status_cd AS state_cd, n.line_cnt AS cnt, n.collect_dt AS dt, n.content FROM tb_log_source s JOIN tb_log_snapshot n ON n.log_id = s.log_id WHERE s.server_id = #{serverId} AND n.snap_id = (SELECT MAX(x.snap_id) FROM tb_log_snapshot x WHERE x.log_id = s.log_id) ORDER BY s.sort_ord, s.log_id
